newsitem.title: GERMANY: SWIMMING-PANKRATOV MAKES UP FOR PARIS DISAPPOINTMENT WITH RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-PANKRATOV MAKES UP FOR PARIS DISAPPOINTMENT WITH RECORD.

text.p: Russia's double Olympic champion Denis Pankratov, who missed out on two short- course world records in Paris a year ago because of a technicality, put his name firmly in the record books on Saturday.

Pankratov, whose best marks in the 100 and 200 butterfly almost one year ago to the day were not recognised because organisers failed to carry out a drug test, set a world record for the short-course 200 metres butterfly at a World Cup meeting.
He clocked one minute 52.64 seconds to beat the previous best of 1:53.05 set by France's Franc Esposito in Paris in February 1994.
The record, the second world mark of the meeting, earned the Russian a bonus of $2,000 and a chance to win a car for the best performance of the two-day meeting.
